data.title: 中野五月 · 深夜书桌前的专注题海
data.description: 深夜静谧的书桌前，台灯柔和的光晕笼罩着摊开的模拟试卷。戴着黑框眼镜的五月一手按着笔记本一手转着水笔，神情坚毅认真地攻克考题。
data.action: studying at desk, wearing glasses, pen in mouth, focused frown
data.promptProse: Late at night in her bedroom, Nakano Itsuki studies earnestly at a wooden desk under a glowing desk lamp. Wearing delicate half-rim glasses, she rests a pen against her lower lip with deep concentration, textbooks stacked around her.
data.animaCaption: Focused over her study notes late at night wearing glasses, warm lamplight illuminates her determined face.
